title: DOCI Version Entry
description: One entry returned by GET /api/versions.php?document_guid=<g>. Versions are themselves documents (doc_type='version') whose file lives at files/.data/versions/<original_guid>/<version_guid>/index.md. Snapshots are created automatically when a thread is started against the document; manual snapshots go through POST /api/versions.php.

original_guid.description: GUID of the live document this snapshot was taken from. Stable across the chain — every version of one document shares this value.

title.description: Title at snapshot time. May differ from the current title of the live document.

created_at.description: When the snapshot was taken. Drives the DV-N labelling order in the UI.

url.description: Direct link to the snapshot's read-only render: `${APP_URL}/${guid}`.
